detailed_descriptions.en: Walk of Life is the ultimate competitive life simulator! Play with up to six players and do whatever it takes to make it to the top! Dive headfirst into the rat race and crush your friends (or our stupid bot players!) in Walk of Life! Do your best to juggle your health, education, career and personal hygiene, all while dodging the hilarious curveballs life throws your way! Will you be a fry cook, a bank manager, or simply rely on the lottery for your income? Compete against friends or bots in a series of boardgame-inspired turns to determine who’s the champion! The opulence! The artistry! The swag! Decorate your apartment to flex your material wealth! Nothing screams ‘success in life’ like a sleek designer couch and a weaponized robot vacuum to protect it from covetous intruders! Leave your friends in awe as you transform your apartment into a veritable Shangri-La of consumer products! You will also be able to express yourself in the literal sense! How multifaceted! Take on one of many roles with vastly different playstyles and embark on not-so-epic quests to score some sweet bonus points! Will you climb to the top of the corporate ladder as the Workaholic, scrounge up valuable artifacts as the Scavenger, or follow your horoscopes as the Mystic? A brand-new engine allows for all sorts of new possibilities, including improved visuals, more fluid gameplay and a slew of other modern features. This cutting-edge technology will leave your eyeballs bulging from the excitement overflowing from your brain! Just take a look at the animations in the Arcade!
